culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Takashi Kamaya. Kamaya took his girlfriend on a date to the restaurant. He called Hosogoe and told him that he had found out the secret ingredient in the recipe to impress his girlfriend. But Hosogoe told him that he didn't use the ingredient anymore and ended up recognising Kamaya, revealing that he worked in the restaurant earlier to Kamaya's date. She ended up dumping him and Kamaya blamed Hosogoe for this, which formed the basis for his motive.
